avatar.face_crop: Presenter crop independent of window; private reference uses same-clock visible source region with measured frame windows. New presenter is a new asset/crop, not a face swap or voice clone.
avatar.synchronization: Whole audio clock retained, scene-local prepared presenter clips align to original global time. Brief presenter delayed2.1s. Keep raw ASR and actual word boundaries; edited caption text never invents new word timing.

graphic.text_policy: Local Chinese font; caption28px in1280 design pixels, short titles32–65px; max two caption lines. Source screenshots retain baked text.
graphic.asset_fit: Evidence contain; presenter cover with explicit native crop. At1920 output,1280-design geometry uniformly scaled1.5; this does not restore missing detail in downloaded reference media.

tutorial.step_mapping: Upload→describe→native visual window→result tied to measured local scene cues; illustrative input and step components distinguished from actual software playback.
tutorial.callout_policy: Chapter bar and scene title are editable; never represent generated UI logs as new successful real operations.

material_edit.source_ranges: Private episode.provenance records original global ranges, exact crops, original playback speed and derived SHA.
material_edit.cut_policy: Half-open scene intervals, source-synchronous visible presenter, no loop/stretch/freeze to hide shortages. Media changes reprepare and invalidate prior review.

rules: Pinned shared host and offline adapters; upstream source unchanged.
Full render requires source/media/bundle-bound actual-frame review and explicit render mode.

Frozen13-scene landscape chapter explainer. Accepted baseline89.266667s/1080p/30fps. New scripts/media/timing require per-episode actual validation; no one-click arbitrary-script or other-aspect claim.
Frozen geometry/motion and palette; new episode text/media/timing stay outside release files.
Music recipe is template-profile.json; private portrait/voice/music defaults are local only.
Only exact accepted episode gets historical passed evidence; new input remains specification/pending until actually checked.

operations.input: Known reference SHA plus local measured transcript, or a new complete authored episode and declared local files.
operations.action: Preserve original clock, prepare reference source regions or copy new files, validate continuous scenes/cues and actual source durations.
operations.output: Private public/content.json, local media and episode.json.
operations.completion: Source identities, full sound duration and enough actual video for every visible window; no provider calls.
operations.recovery: Read existing episode. A frozen output directory is never silently overwritten; choose a new episode or reuse exact existing outputs.

operations.entrypoint: render.cjs bundle; ../../scripts/nana_mint_preview.py --mode frames; Remotion Studio using remotion.config.cjs
operations.input: Validated private episode, existing local runtimes, shared pinned composition host.
operations.action: Bundle same code used by interactive preview, freeze all inputs, submit and execute exact paused local job through unified queue.
operations.output: Frame proofs, original queue/log, editable Studio template/reference/comparison compositions.
operations.completion: Every intended scene and critical state actually reviewed; metadata success alone is insufficient.
operations.recovery: Read jobs.json and original queue/log; preserve completed frame evidence. Input/code changes require a new frozen request.

operations.input: Explicit export request; actual reviewed frame identity and same source/media/bundle.
operations.action: Submit unified local export, preserve whole audio, encode22Mbps CBR and verify actual video>=20Mbps/full decode/frame count.
operations.completion: Actual MP4 technical evidence plus encoded-frame review; listening/user/platform remain independent.
operations.recovery: Reuse source and any complete silent render; no repeated paid stage or publishing.
